documentId.title: Sample Document ID
documentId.description: The sample structured document, if one was given.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Name of the document the job ran on.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: Name of the dataset the document belongs to.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Number of credits used by the operation.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Error message if the job failed.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Job progress percentage (0-100). Used by document upload parsing and V3 standardization jobs.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the transformation should do, as requested.

basedOnTransformationId.title: Based On Transformation ID
basedOnTransformationId.description: The transformation being changed, when this request changes one.

standardizationId.title: Sample Standardization ID
standardizationId.description: The sample standardization, if one was given.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: What the job is doing while it runs: writing the code, testing it on the sample, or reviewing it.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: How many times the code has been written so far; above 1 means an earlier attempt failed testing.

maxAttempts.title: Max Attempts
maxAttempts.description: The most attempts the job makes before giving up.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Set when the job completes: approved (the transformation was saved) or rejected.

transformationId.title: Transformation ID
transformationId.description: The saved transformation's ID, set only when approved.

code.title: Code
code.description: The Python code that was reviewed.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: What the code does, in plain words.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The code's output on the sample, when a sample was given and the output fits.

previewTruncated.title: Preview Truncated
previewTruncated.description: True when the output on the sample was too large to include.

approved.title: Approved
approved.description: Whether the review approved the code.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The review's reasoning, in plain words.
